    {
      "Candidate Name": "FIFO-size build choice",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_twi",

conceptual assets.information: The software-programmable enable state that turns TWI operation, FIFO activity and the external clock-generation path on or off; controller operation depends on it.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Integrity is at risk because an unchecked bus write changes ctrl.enable at line 136, and availability is at risk because it resets the clock generator at lines 252-254, clears both FIFOs at line 168 and drives the clock-enable output at line 270.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker can write the control register with enable cleared, disabling clock generation and clearing queued transfers.

conceptual assets.information: The prescaler and clock-divider settings that determine when TWI bit phases advance and therefore determine the serial transfer rate.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Integrity is at risk because bus writes modify ctrl.prsc and ctrl.cdiv at lines 137-138, while availability is at risk because those settings control clock-generator advancement and tick generation at lines 257-264, so an attacker can stall or excessively alter transfers.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker can overwrite the prescaler or divider so TWI transfers run at an incorrect rate or fail to advance.

conceptual assets.information: The command and acknowledge-control bits in a transmit word that select the TWI operation and its wire sequencing; the engine depends on them to perform the requested transaction.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Integrity is at risk because bus data enters the transmit word at line 198 and is loaded into the engine command state at lines 327-329, while availability is at risk because command execution waits for FIFO availability and a timing tick at line 328 and can be withheld by the transmit-read gating at line 199.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker can replace or withhold a queued command so the peripheral performs the wrong TWI operation or never starts it.

conceptual assets.information: Payload bytes supplied for transmission on the TWI data line; the engine shifts this information into the serial transfer.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Confidentiality is at risk because transmit payload loaded into engine.sreg at line 327 is exposed through the serial output path at lines 374 and 406, integrity is at risk because bus writes supply the payload at line 198, and availability is at risk because FIFO clearing and transmit-read gating at lines 168 and 199 can discard or withhold it.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker can read the serially emitted payload, replace a bus-written byte, or clear the transmit FIFO before the byte is sent.

conceptual assets.information: Payload bytes sampled from the TWI data line; the engine captures them and the receive path makes them available to software through the bus response.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Confidentiality is at risk because sampled data is returned through bus_rsp_o.data at line 156, integrity is at risk because the captured value is formed from the sampled input at line 378, and availability is at risk because receive storage is only written on engine.done at line 229 and can be cleared at line 168 before software reads it.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker can observe the bus read-back, alter sampled serial data, or clear or prevent receive storage so an inbound byte is lost.

conceptual assets.information: The interrupt indication that reports an enabled, idle transmitter with no queued transmit word; system software relies on it to service further TWI transfers.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Integrity is at risk because the interrupt value is produced from enable, FIFO availability and engine state at line 239 and can therefore be falsely asserted or suppressed, while availability is at risk because suppressing irq_o can prevent software from refilling the transmitter and stall transfers.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker can manipulate the internal conditions or interrupt path so software does not receive the service request and queued TWI activity stops.
